intent: Tailwind sprint through the barley: pulsing gusts, polished ice lanes with stone braking bays and awn brambles. Read the gust, commit, brake on stone. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

sections.name: The hot tailwind
sections.lesson: The wind gusts and dies · vault the awn beds, brake on the stacks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

signs.text:
The hot tailwind
Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: Polished threshing boards
sections.lesson: Carry speed across the polished ice · stop on stone. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: Between the harvest walls
sections.lesson: Gusting walls of barley · vault low between the awns. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

sections.name: The granary walk

sections.name: The long hot straight
sections.lesson: Commit to the cuts between gusts, then brake on the wide stacks. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
